create_guest_pass.name: Create guest pass
create_guest_pass.description: Creates a time-limited UniFi Access guest pass (visitor) with a PIN or QR code.

door_id.name: Door IDs
door_id.description: One or more IDs of the doors the guest may access.

credentials.name: Credential types
credentials.description: Which credentials to issue — PIN code, QR code, or both.

revoke_guest_pass.name: Revoke guest pass
revoke_guest_pass.description: Revokes a guest pass — the PIN or QR code stops working immediately.

visitor_id.name: Visitor ID
visitor_id.description: ID of the guest pass to revoke.

extend_guest_pass.name: Extend / reactivate guest pass
extend_guest_pass.description: Assigns a new validity window to an existing guest pass, reactivating it without re-creating the guest. The PIN or QR code stays the same.

visitor_id.name: Visitor ID
visitor_id.description: ID of the guest pass to extend.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: New start of the access window.

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: New end of the access window.

list_guest_passes.name: List guest passes
list_guest_passes.description: Returns the available doors and all registered guest passes; used by the dashboard card.

trigger_doorbell.name: Trigger doorbell
trigger_doorbell.description: Rings the doorbell on an intercom or reader (requires UniFi Access 4.0.10 or later).

door_id.name: Door ID
door_id.description: Ring the doorbell of this door's intercom/reader. Use either this or a device ID.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Ring the doorbell on this specific intercom/reader. Use either this or a door ID.

room_name.name: Room name
room_name.description: Optional intercom directory entry to call.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Stop a doorbell that is still ringing instead of starting one.

delete_guest_pass.name: Delete guest pass
delete_guest_pass.description: Permanently deletes a guest pass and removes it from UniFi Access. This cannot be undone — use 'Revoke guest pass' to only disable access.

visitor_id.name: Visitor ID
visitor_id.description: ID of the guest pass to delete permanently.
